common:generalComment.#text: Anhydrous sodium sulfate is a type of sodium sulfate mineral that does not contain water. It belongs to the monoclinic crystal system, and its crystals are biconical, prismatic, or tabular. Aggregates are granular, powdery, or in block form. It can be colorless, grayish-white, yellow, or yellow-brown, and ranges from transparent to translucent. It exhibits a vitreous or resinous luster, with a white streak. It has a hardness of 2.5-3 and a density of 2.66-2.7g/cm3. Anhydrous sodium sulfate is highly soluble in water and imparts a cooling sensation. It has a cool and slightly salty taste. In humid air, it easily undergoes hydration, transforming into a powdery form of hydrated sodium sulfate on the surface. Anhydrous sodium sulfate is found in salt lakes containing sodium sulfate brine, where it coexists with mirabilite, gypsum, thenardite, bloedite, glauberite, halite, and trona. It can also be dehydrated from mirabilite, and small amounts can be found around volcanic fumaroles.

元明粉是一种不含水的钠硫酸盐矿物。斜方晶系，晶体呈双锥状、柱状或板状，集合体呈粒状、粉末状或块状。无色、灰白色、黄色或黄棕色。透明至半透明。玻璃光泽或松脂光泽。条痕白色。硬度2.5～3，密度2.66～2.7g/cm3。极易溶于水。有凉感。味清凉而带咸。在潮湿空气中易水化，转变成粉末状含水硫酸钠覆盖于表面。无水芒硝产于含硫酸钠卤水的盐湖中，与芒硝、钙芒硝、泻利盐白钠镁矾、石膏、盐镁芒硝、石盐、泡碱等共生；也可由芒硝脱水而成；火山喷气孔周围有少量产出。

common:generalComment.#text: Calcium oxide (CaO), also known as quicklime or lime, is a compound of one atom of calcium and one atom of oxygen. It is a white or grayish white solid produced in large quantities by roasting calcium carbonate to drive off carbon dioxide. At room temperature, it will spontaneously absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. It is a widely used material and is a white, caustic, alkaline solid at room temperature.
氧化钙（CaO）又称生石灰或石灰，是由一个钙原子和一个氧原子组成的化合物。它是一种白色或灰白色固体，通过焙烧碳酸钙以驱除二氧化碳而大量生成。在室温下，它会自发吸收大气中的二氧化碳。它是一种广泛使用的材料，在室温下呈白色、腐蚀性、碱性固体。

common:generalComment.#text: Aluminium sulfate in powder form, typically used as a coagulating agent in the purification of drinking water and wastewater treatment plants, and also in paper manufacturing. The product is processed to achieve a powdered consistency, adheres to relevant quality standards, and is manufactured through a chemical production route. It is commonly available as a consumption mix to consumers and as a bulk product at plant level.
硫酸铝粉末形式，通常用作饮用水和污水处理厂的絮凝剂，以及造纸工业中。该产品加工成粉末状，符合相应的质量标准，通过化学生产路线制造。它通常作为消费混合物供消费者使用，也作为工厂级别的散装产品。

common:generalComment.#text: Hog fuel is ground up or powdered wood used for fuel. It is a lumberyard byproduct comprised of sawdust, wood chips, shavings and bark. It is also known as wood waste and is a sustainable and renewable resource. It used to be burned or put in landfills, and this legislation is necessary to make it economically viable as clean power. Biomass generators are another building block to make timber and farm operations profitable and sustainable.
木屑燃料是磨碎的或粉末状的木材用作燃料。它是一种伐木场的副产品，由木屑、木屑、刨花和树皮组成。它也被称为木材废料，是一种可持续的可再生资源。它曾经被焚烧或填埋，这项立法是必要的，以使其作为清洁能源在经济上可行。生物质发电是使木材和农场运营有利可图和可持续发展的另一个组成部分。

common:generalComment.#text: Sulfuric acid is a highly corrosive strong mineral acid with a chemical formula H2SO4. It is colorless to slightly yellow in liquid form and is soluble in water at all concentrations. The acid is used in various applications including mineral processing, fertilizer manufacturing, oil refining, waste water processing, and chemical synthesis. It is produced through the contact process by the oxidation of sulfur trioxide, which is further hydrated with water. Sulfuric acid is available commercially at various concentrations and can be found in both industrial and laboratory settings.
硫酸是一种高度腐蚀性的强矿酸，化学式为H2SO4。它为无色至微黄色液体，可在所有浓度下溶于水。硫酸在多种应用中被使用，包括矿物加工、肥料制造、石油精炼、废水处理和化学合成。它通过接触法制得，即通过氧化三氧化硫制得，然后与水水合。硬山在不同浓度流通，可在工业和实验室环境中找到。
